02 / About

The work is in the details.

Panel → Logic → Motion

Automation is only dependable when every layer agrees: the logic, the sensor, the actuator, the operator and the machine around it. Sagar brings practical experience across the full path from control panel and schematics to machine startup, troubleshooting and customer handover. He works comfortably between engineering, maintenance, production and operators — translating a fault into a fix that holds.

Clear logic. Strong traceability. Fewer surprises.

A / 01
